description: Everything that stands between the film and a good export, in one answer: example words and lists nobody rewrote (by shot, with the keys set_text and set_shot take), pictures not given yet or that cannot be drawn, the brand's name and logo, text contrast (WCAG, 4.5), long texts, lines the film does not leave the time to read, shots too short for what they hold, the film's and each shot's length in seconds, music and sounds, premium pieces, and what the plan exports. It ends with `next`: what to do, in order. Run it before export_film and before telling the user the film is done.

formats.description: The formats meant for export (default: the film's own): the plan is checked for each

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

uhd.description: true checks the plan for a 4K export
